messages:
tess: CI caught a bunch of broken fragment links after the mdx migration. stack trace points to missing anchors across a couple pages.

ci-bot: build: docs/mkdocs: linkcheck failed (exit 2). 9 broken links. details: https://ci.redwood/example/5899 :warning:

omar: examples from the log:
```
WARNING: broken link: ../tutorials/onnx-serve#runtime-opts -> 404
WARNING: broken link: ../reference/cli#deploy-options -> 404
```

lee: pattern: headings with parentheses and code like `--opt` got slugged weirdly (parentheses stripped, code backticks converted). cross-page links used old slug.

tess: plan: do surgical fixes only for files listed in CI. add explicit header ids `{#...}` using ascii kebab-case. avoid touching unrelated docs.

omar: +1. also add a short CONTRIBUTING note recommending explicit ids for headings that contain code, parentheses, or non-ascii.

lee: i can ship a tiny script that maps linkcheck failures to candidate heading ids and shows a quick patch preview. will push to scripts/anchor_suggester.py.

ci-bot: note: re-run of linkcheck will be triggered once PR branch receives new commits.

tess: created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4380 with 7 explicit ids and the contributing update. please review.

docs-bot: suggestion: consider adding linkcheck output parsing to CI to annotate PRs with exact anchor mismatches. i'll file an issue.

lee: small request: use deterministic ids like `run-options` instead of `runtime-opts` so future writers find them readable.

omar: updated PR with suggested ids. re-ran mkdocs linkcheck locally, all green.

ci-bot: re-run queued for PR 4380...

(last) tess: thanks team. will merge on green and follow up to run a full site build on main to ensure no regressions. :thumbsup:
